what_it_measured.text: The soy-derived peptide Lunasin inhibits invasive potential of melanoma initiating cells

dose.text: Throughout the experiment, mice were dosed daily with vehicle or Lunasin (30 mg/kg) by intraperitoneal (IP) injection.
Immediately following transplantation of melanoma cells, mice were dosed with Lunasin (30 mg / kg) or vehicle by intraperitoneal (IP) injection.

route.text: Throughout the experiment, mice were dosed daily with vehicle or Lunasin (30 mg/kg) by intraperitoneal (IP) injection.

Mice received daily IP injections of Lunasin or vehicle until the end of the experiment 18 days post-transplantation of cells; preliminary studies demonstrated that this protocol generated numerous large lesions 22 days after injection.

endpoint.text: Mutated peptides were synthesized by China Peptides (Shanghai, China) with purity > 95% as assessed by HPLC/MS.

Briefly, cells were treated for 24 h with vehicle or Lunasin, harvested by trypsinization, counted, and assessed for viability by trypan blue exclusion. 1x106 cells were washed in PBS, and resuspended in 200 μL ice-cold PBS.
ALDH activity was evaluated using the ALDEFLUORTM (StemCell Technologies) staining kit as described [37].

reported_results.text: Mice in the control group averaged 45 (± 22) observable pulmonary lesions compared to only 9.5 (± 8) in Lunasin-treated mice (Figure 5A).
Treatment reduced the mean percentage of ALDH-positive B16-F10 cells from 8% in the control samples to 1.9% in the Lunasin-treated samples (p = 0.029).

Treatment with 100 μM Lunasin reduced oncosphere formation by 29% (p = 0.005, Figure 3B).Additionally, we observed a decrease in theALDHhigh population when cells were treated with 100 μM Lunasin for 24 h (Figure 3C and 3D).

Conversely, cells treated with native Lunasin (p < 0.001) and the scrambled tail peptide (p = 0.0013) had a significantly reduced ability to form oncospheres in anchorage-independent culture (Figure 8A and 8B).
